Title: Artists: Portfolio review opportunity at Dragon*Con

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
From the White Wolf home page:

White Wolf will be holding portfolio reviews on Saturday, August 30th and Sunday
the 31st from 12 noon to 2 p.m. at the White Wolf Booth. Come talk to art directors
Becky Jollensten (Dark Ages and Orpheus), Brian Glass (Exalted and VTES), Mike Chaney
(Sword & Sorcery) and Pauline Benney (Demon: The Fallen), and bring your portfolio with
you. And we will have Orpheus with us at the show, too!

--
